description: A promoted verification rung used 'uv run --project _project/scripts -- python -m pytest ...', but that isolated project does not declare pytest, so the command fails before collection on every tree. Make todo-db lint detect verification commands that invoke pytest through a selected uv project without declaring or injecting pytest. The check must resolve the selected pyproject from the current repository, accept root/default dev dependencies and explicit '--with pytest' or selected extras, and remain conservative for shell constructs it cannot prove. This makes the recorded ladder replayable without ambient environment mutation while leaving valid isolated-tool commands unchanged.

verifications.expected: exits 5 on the unfixed tree because no matching test is collected; exits 0 after the rule and controls land

work_units.evidence: Reproduced in a clean BenchBox worktree: uv run --project _project/scripts --frozen -- python -m pytest --version exits 1 with No module named pytest; root uv run --frozen -- python -m pytest --version exits 0 with pytest 9.1.1. Contract accepts selected-project declarations, default groups/extras, or explicit --with injection and skips ambiguous forms.
work_units.summary: Reproduce the cross-project pytest failure and define conservative accepted and rejected uv command forms

work_units.evidence: Canonical todo-db lint statically resolves uv --project manifests and enabled base/default-group/extra dependencies, flags the live todo-cli-local-fallback-guard seq2 rung, honors --no-dev/--only-group, and accepts explicit --with or requirements injection without executing commands.
work_units.summary: Implement todo-db lint detection for pytest missing from the selected uv project environment

work_units.evidence: CHANGELOG documents the static replayability contract; 13 uv-project positive/negative controls pass, the live historical bad rung is detected, Ruff passes, and the full canonical suite passes 124 tests.
work_units.summary: Add positive and negative controls, document the contract, and run focused plus full package gates
